Explore freely · Fix one step at a time · No timer. No lost lives.

Welcome to the rescue crew!

Drive with the green arrows or your keyboard. Roads are light gray. Buildings, trees and hydrants cannot be driven through.

Park directly beside a building—up, down, left or right. Choose Spray to put out its fire, then Rescue. One full tank handles one fire.

When your tank is empty, park beside a blue hydrant and choose Fill.

Your driving actions appear in notes. Switch to Build code and put the same actions into a program. Test it, or try one step at a time.

Build your own rescue town

Choose a tile, then tap the map to paint. Place one truck station, up to three animal houses, roads, trees, and hydrants.

Changing size starts a fresh map. Your draft saves on this browser.
